References found in the latest WhatsApp TestFlight version suggest Meta is working on providing an alternative to iCloud backups for iPhone users. Details below.

WhatsApp is developing its own backup service

According to findings by WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is developing its own cloud backup service for iPhone users, offering an alternative to iCloud.

This feature is not yet available to WhatsApp TestFlight users, but WABetaInfo managed to activate an interface allowing users to choose between iCloud or WhatsApp's own cloud service for backups. The interface shows 2GB of free storage will be offered, and the report also indicates that paid plans could go up to 1TB.

The report also mentions that users can choose whether their WhatsApp backups on iCloud use end-to-end encryption, while WhatsApp's own backup system uses end-to-end encryption by default.

Although there is no official launch timeline for this feature yet, the report indicates WhatsApp is also developing alternatives to Google Drive backups for Android users. Since development work on both platforms is underway, the feature may be officially announced soon.
